notes: ScopedReadSharesV1 (card T05). Two children each requesting the whole 1024-unit read authority for one allocation exceeds the lending budget, and the excess request is refused as a whole with the outstanding total and the request named. The accepted control lends 511 and 513 of the same allocation, so the boundary is a boundary rather than a blanket refusal of two borrowers.

controls.note: 511 + 513 = 1024 checks, so ShareExceedsAuthority is keyed to the total exceeding the budget and not to two children holding shares.
